outcome: Morphine Milligram Equivalents (MMEs) administered in hospital
cohort: The study participants were women who gave birth at a Level II community hospital in Southwestern Ohio between July 2017 and June 2019.
finding: The PainPack Protocol was associated with a significant reduction in opioids administered during postpartum hospitalization and prescribed at discharge, while maintaining reported effective pain control.
mod_finding: The protocol reduced both in-hospital and discharge opioid amounts for women who birthed via cesarean and those who birthed vaginally.
